text:
Alex: Quick async check — procurement just flagged a custom breaker delay for DC-E racks; ETA slipped. Can we confirm impact on dedicated reservations next week? CC @Marta @Samir
Marta: Saw the vendor note. They quoted 3-5 business days for custom breakers. Which rack IDs are we talking about?
Samir: Affected: racks e2 and e3 in DC-E (those back the dedicated-sku-48 pool). If >3d we lose target capacity for the 48x H100 onboarding window.
Julie: Ops looked — we can reroute those 24 units to DC-W but that requires a new shipping manifest and customs hold (~48h). What are the tradeoffs/costs?
Kevin: Legal + customs pinged. Also there's an infra PR that would add a fallback region for reservations: infra/capacity/configs/2026/fallback-dc-w.yaml PR#4721 — needs review before we rely on it.
Alex: Pasting the config snippet for visibility:
```
fallback:
  region: dc-w
  max_instances: 24
  allowed_models: [gptx-base, gptx-compact]
```
Can infra/plat review? @Kevin @Marta
Marta: Reviewing now. Small nit: allowed_models should include the quantized variants. Also we need to preserve KV-cache affinity label on fallback racks to avoid latency regression for dedicated-sku-48.
ops-bot: Reservation reminder — dedicated-resv-48 expires in 4 days unless actioned.
Samir: If we accept fallback, we must update SLAs and notify sales/customers. I'll open SR-8891 to handle billing prorates and customer notifications.
Julie: Prefer to keep primary DC-E. Suggest a split-ship to unblock canaries: ship 24 units now to DC-E and ship the remainder when breakers arrive. Vendor can split-ship for +$1.2k.
Alex: OK to greenlight split-ship if infra signs off. @Marta can you approve for 24 units today?
Marta: Approved for the 24-unit split-ship. I'll create change request CR-3152 and tag the racks with power:split-ship. Adding rack-power and kv-cache labels.
Kevin: Merged PR#4721 with the fallback region + kv-cache label tweak. Left a comment asking for a small unit test. @Samir can you run the staging smoke once the manifest is updated? Suggested command:
```
./scripts/smoke_capacity.sh --region dc-w --model gptx-compact
```
Samir: Will update manifest and run smoke today EOD. Also pinging sales: @Julie can you notify the customer that the onboarding window may drift by ~48h if breakers delay persists?
Julie: Notified sales in #sales, they confirmed customer is OK with a 48h contingency but wants to be told immediately if >72h.
Alex: Thanks all. FYI firmware window for the breakers is Tue 09:00-11:00 UTC — flagging for oncall as a risk period.
ops-bot: Deploy-check: no active canaries in DC-E during the firmware window.
Marta: Updated CR notes: "preserve KV cache affinity when fallback active" and added a follow-up task to validate latency histograms post-fallback.
Alex: Closing loop: plan = split-ship 24 units to keep canaries, merged fallback config for DC-W, smoke test EOD, sales/customer notified, update dedicated-resv ticket with plan + new ETA. TL;DR: unblock canaries now, full capacity when breakers arrive. :thumbsup:
